segments.name: team collaboration software
segments.description: Atlassian sells team collaboration software, cloud apps, AI agents and Collections, to organizations of all sizes from small companies to large enterprises.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company has determined it operates as a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay subscription fees to use Atlassian's cloud software, on-premises Data Center term licenses, premier support, and Marketplace third-party apps.
revenueModel.evidence: Subscription revenues consist primarily of fees earned from subscription-based arrangements for providing customers the right to use our software in a cloud-based-infrastructure that we provide.

changes.text: In 2025 the company announced plans to end-of-life its Data Center offering, no longer selling new term licenses.
changes.evidence: In September 2025, the Company announced plans to end-of-life its Data Center offering.
